## CLI commands

Names below are parsed declarations. Inspect --help and the maintenance guide before invoking commands against an installation.

| Command | Source help |
| --- | --- |
| `backup` | Back up SQLite and referenced uploads privately. |
| `check-config` | Validate startup settings without displaying secrets. |
| `cleanup-account-files` | Retry queued account file removals. |
| `cleanup-community-media` | See --help. |
| `consolidate-duplicate-vacancies` | Consolidate published URL aliases, retaining history. |
| `expand-opportunity-discovery` | Search across more healthcare and programme websites. |
| `maintain-evidence` | Check legacy evidence and purge expired private files. |
| `maintain-message-files` | Remove unfinished conversation uploads and crash remnants. |
| `notification-worker` | Deliver opted-in notification emails. |
| `prune-backups` | Remove expired automatic backups. |
| `reassess-incomplete-vacancies` | List fresh adverts with missing optional details. |
| `reconcile-vacancies` | Clean duplicate/non-vacancy review work. |
| `recruitment-init` | Set up Nigerian-first schedules and pending starter sources. |
| `recruitment-worker` | Run the source-discovery queue. |
| `reels-worker` | Process queued Reels videos. |
| `restore-backup` | Restore to a NEW private directory. |
| `set-collection-channel` | Select a channel within an already approved publisher. |
| `set-staff` | Operator bootstrap/recovery staff flag change; accepts an existing account phone. |
| `unset-staff` | Operator bootstrap/recovery staff flag change; accepts an existing account phone. |
| `vacancy-coverage` | Measure current public jobs and review blockers. |
| `worker-status` | Check database and worker progress. |
| `workers` | Supervise and restart background workers. |
